title: Whalefall Rotten Tomatoes score? Above 70
rules: If Whalefall has a Tomatometer score of above 70 on Oct 19, 2026 at 10:00 AM ET, then the market resolves to Yes.
rules_secondary:
The "Fresh!" and "Certified Fresh!" subtitles are meant for illustrative purposes only. The Tomatometer score must be above the strike value to resolve as YES (for example, a score of 75 would resolve "Above 75" as No.) The market will be determined the Monday after wide release at 10:00 AM ET.

This market and these products have not been endorsed by Rotten Tomatoes. Any references to Rotten Tomatoes or any associated marks are descriptive only and do not indicate an endorsement of this product or any affiliation between Rotten Tomatoes and Kalshi.

blind.reasoning: Early social reactions to Whalefall are described as largely positive but noticeably mixed: Austin Abrams' performance and the tension get praise, while several critics call the father-son material overly sentimental. Brian Duffield's two earlier films were well reviewed, and the studio's early-screening strategy suggests confidence. Mixed reactions before the embargo usually point to a Tomatometer in the 60s to low 80s, so above 70 is modestly more likely than not.
blind.falsifier: When the review embargo lifts on October 14, the Tomatometer opens in the 60s or lower and stays at or below 70 through Monday, October 19, with critics widely calling the film sappy or the whale premise silly.

final.reasoning: The market at 0.665 is a little above my 0.60, and I nudge up to 0.63 in case it reflects information I didn't find. The remaining gap of about 3.5 points is too small to bet on, since the outcome depends on reviews that haven't been published yet.
